naam: Agastya rishi Ram ji ke darbar mein
kya_aaya: Rishi Ayodhya aaye; Agastya ne kaha ki Meghnad Ravan se bhi shaktishali tha. Ram ji ne poocha kyun.
baaki: Ravan ka vansh: Pulastya rishi aur Vishrava ki katha

naam: Ravan ke pita Vishravas ka janm
kya_aaya: Pulastya rishi ka shraap, Trinabindu ki beti se vivah aur Ravan ke pita Vishrava ka janm.

naam: Kuber ko Lanka kaise mili
kya_aaya: Vishrava ke putra Vaishravan (Kuber) ka tap, Brahma ji se lokpal ka var aur Pushpak, aur pita ke kehne par Lanka ke raja bane.
